page_findings.observation: Final title and the revised opening fit cleanly. The two opening paragraphs now occupy three and two normal lines. Translation and prerequisite blocks are readable; full Theorem 1.1 and full Lemma 1.2 now both fit on page 1, including the continuous-representative conclusion.

The criterion explanation leads into compact interval integrals and the two Ehrling displays. Both ordered choices and the continuous-B extension are legible. Full Theorem 2.1 and its short orientation fit below; its long hypothesis paragraph is a deliberate complete-statement exception.

The nonlinear cut-off definitions, K(0)-inclusive tail and finite-net hull inclusion are separated and uncut. The measurable averaging paragraph is three lines, followed by its display. The r=1 noncoverage and scope limit are each short blocks; no overflow or isolated formula tag is visible.

Full cone Theorem 3.1 and two-point Lemma 3.2 remain intact, including the exponent exclusion and no-subtraction conditions. Their longer hypothesis blocks are retained intentionally. Normalization displays are clear; the W11 bound begins subsection 3.1 without clipping.

The Fubini, finite-p and supremum estimates have distinct tags and readable right margins. The cone amplitude, gauge tail and norm-upgrade estimates are also complete. Ordinary explanations, including the scoped source-gap note, remain short and distinguish weak A1 from strong A0.

The comparison table has three readable columns and no text collisions; it states operations and spaces. The complete homogeneous proposition has two deliberately long condition/conclusion blocks. Its inverse-gauge calculations and lift bound fit below with enough separation to follow their uses.

The overlap qualification finishes at the top. The dyadic distance calculation and ramp definition, derivative norm, continuity obstruction and finite-p error are all legible. The local synthesis paragraph at the bottom is three lines; no theorem hypothesis has been hidden by compression.

The final synthesis qualification, exact-version note and evidence-scope note are short paragraphs. All three bibliography entries remain legible with their identifying metadata and hanging layout. The lower-page whitespace is natural end matter, not an empty or truncated page.
